# ExeNovaLink 2.0.0

DiscordSRVStatusEmbed is now **ExeNovaLink**, an all-in-one Discord ↔ Minecraft plugin with its own bot. DiscordSRV is no longer required.

## New

- Own Discord bot (JDA 5), configured with `discord.bot-token`.
- Two-way chat bridge with webhook player avatars; join, leave, death, advancement and start/stop messages.
- Account linking (`/link` in game, in Discord, or by DM), an optional link-to-join gate, linked role, nickname sync and `/whois`.
- Role sync from LuckPerms or any permission plugin's `group.<name>` permissions.
- Discord console channel with a staff-only command allowlist.
- Punishment log (AdvancedBan, LiteBans, EssentialsX, CMI or any ban plugin), vote announcements and stats channel names.
- Integrations: PlaceholderAPI, LuckPerms, EssentialsX, vanish plugins, Geyser/Floodgate, AdvancedBan, Votifier and DiscordSRV links.
- `/exenova` admin command and new `%exenovalink_*%` placeholders.

## Fixed

- Duplicate Discord replies after a plugin reload.
- `/exenova reload` now also reloads automations and schedules.
- Log purge no longer re-deletes the same messages.
- `/purge` feedback is now actually sent.
- `!players` no longer fails with more than 25 players online.
- Verification now reports the real result of the role change.
- Suggestion "Considering" and "Planned" no longer count as denied.
- `PLAYER_DEATH` automations now have a player.
- Report state is now thread-safe, and report details can never reach the chat bridge.
- Menus can no longer be spoofed with renamed chests.
- Leaderboard performance and tab completion fixes.

## Upgrading

Your existing settings are copied from `plugins/DiscordSRVStatusEmbed`. Set `discord.bot-token` (and `discord.guild-id`), then run `/exenova reload`. Old commands, permissions and placeholders keep working.
